DEVICE-1.name: NOT_A_DEVICE_NAME
DEVICE-1.description: Raised when a device key is asked for under a word that cannot name one.

DEVICE-10.name: CHALLENGE_NOT_STANDING
DEVICE-10.description: Raised when a mint carries a challenge that does not stand.

DEVICE-11.name: SIGNATURE_WRONG
DEVICE-11.description: Raised when a mint's signature does not verify against the device key.

DEVICE-12.name: NO_CHALLENGE
DEVICE-12.description: Raised when this machine would not supply the bytes a challenge is made of.

DEVICE-13.name: ATTESTATION_REVOKED
DEVICE-13.description: Raised when an attestation's chain carries a certificate Google lists as revoked or suspended.

DEVICE-2.name: DEVICE_NAME_TAKEN
DEVICE-2.description: Raised when a device key is registered under a name another device key holds.

DEVICE-3.name: PUBLIC_HALF_TAKEN
DEVICE-3.description: Raised when a device key is registered with a public half another device key holds.

DEVICE-4.name: NOT_P256
DEVICE-4.description: Raised when the public half given is not a P-256 key.

DEVICE-5.name: NO_ATTESTATION
DEVICE-5.description: Raised when a device key is registered with no attestation.

DEVICE-6.name: ATTESTATION_UNVERIFIED
DEVICE-6.description: Raised when an attestation does not verify, or does not cover the public half.

DEVICE-7.name: IN_SOFTWARE
DEVICE-7.description: Raised when an attestation places the key in software, or says it was not made in the hardware that keeps it.

DEVICE-8.name: UNTRUSTED_APP
DEVICE-8.description: Raised when an attestation names an app this stack does not trust.

DEVICE-9.name: NOT_REGISTERED
DEVICE-9.description: Raised when a device key named is not registered, or was revoked.
